reason: H0 exclusively initializes and drives wuffs_json__decoder and explicitly compiles WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON, while S1 changes JPEG MCU entropy-decoding functions that consume Huffman-coded bitstreams. No H0 path initializes a wuffs_jpeg__decoder or supplies JPEG input, so the implicated JPEG attack surface is absent.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__AUX__JSON but not a JPEG module.
H0 calls wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson; it contains no wuffs_jpeg__decoder entry point.
All three changed functions read f_bitstream_bits and f_huff_tables_fast and decode AC/DC symbols from JPEG bitstream data.
The progressive paths use f_scan_al, f_scan_se, f_eob_run, and f_mcu_zig_index, states and input semantics not modeled by the JSON harness.
recommended_action: Add a JPEG fuzz harness that enables the JPEG module and drives wuffs_jpeg__decoder on arbitrary inputs with incremental source buffers, including baseline and progressive scans, so the three MCU decoding paths and their suspension/resumption state are exercised.
